info.name: AgentPay 2.0 — End-to-End PayPal Sandbox + Sponsor API
info.description: Run in order. This collection calls the live AgentPay backend. Run AI Agent first, run the tamper request (must be blocked), then create a Sandbox order. Open approveUrl in a browser and approve with a PayPal Sandbox buyer before running Capture. Only then run Purchase Proof and optional Render Workflow Reconciliation. Never use production credentials or real money.

request.description: Confirm backend configuration and database status. Verify the response reports the expected Sandbox configuration.

This request is deliberately bounded and includes an explicit budget. Requires PostgreSQL and OpenAI credentials. If the response says deterministic-fallback, do not claim the live AI path in the demo.

exec: pm.test('A signed mandate and non-empty cart are returned', function () { pm.expect(d.mandate && d.mandate.mandateId).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(d.selectedItems).to.be.an('array').that.is.not.empty; });
pm.test('Policy must pass before checkout', function () { pm.expect(d.policy.status).to.eql('PASS'); });
const items = d.selectedItems.map(({ id, quantity }) => ({ id, quantity }));
const tampered = items.map((item, index) => index === 0 ? { ...item, id: alternative?.id || '__agentpay_unapproved_sku__' } : item);
pm.collectionVariables.set('tamperMode', alternative ? 'approved-catalogue SKU substitution' : 'unapproved SKU substitution');
pm.test('Live AI path is used for the AI claim', function () { pm.expect(d.agentMode).to.eql('openai-tools'); });

item.name: 03 — Reject Tampered Cart (must fail before PayPal)

request.description: This changes the selected SKU after the mandate was signed. Expected: HTTP 403 and paypalOrderCreated=false. The request must be rejected by the real create-order route, before any PayPal order call.

exec: pm.test('Tampered cart is blocked with HTTP 403', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(403); });
pm.test('No PayPal order was created', function () { pm.expect(d.blocked).to.eql(true); pm.expect(d.paypalOrderCreated).to.eql(false); });

request.description: Creates a PayPal Sandbox order only after the server verifies the stored mandate, exact cart, canonical catalogue prices and deterministic policy. The response includes approveUrl when PayPal returns an approval link. Open it in a browser and approve using a PayPal Sandbox buyer before running the next request.

exec: pm.test('PayPal order is created', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('Approval URL is returned for manual Sandbox approval', function () { pm.expect(d.approveUrl).to.be.a('string').and.match(/^https:\/\//); });

request.description: Precondition: open the saved approveUrl in a browser and approve the order with a Sandbox buyer. Then run this request. The backend re-fetches the PayPal order, verifies the mandate/cart/amount/currency and captures server-side.

exec: pm.test('Completed capture ID is present', function () { pm.expect(d.status).to.eql('COMPLETED'); pm.expect(d.captureId).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; });

request.description: Fetch the complete proof after capture. Confirm real PayPal order/capture IDs, matching amount/currency, and audit.integrity.status = VERIFIED. If legacy events are present, review the legacy event count.

exec: pm.test('Proof links the PayPal order and capture', function () { pm.expect(d.payment.orderId).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('orderID')); pm.expect(d.payment.captureId).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('captureId')); pm.expect(d.payment.captureStatus).to.eql('COMPLETED'); });
pm.test('Audit chain is verified', function () { pm.expect(['VERIFIED', 'VERIFIED_WITH_LEGACY_EVENTS']).to.include(d.audit.integrity.status); });

request.description: Optional. Set workflowSecret to the same WORKFLOW_SHARED_SECRET configured on the backend. Only call this after successful capture. Repeating the same capture is expected to return duplicate=true without appending duplicate reconciliation evidence.
Run after the first successful reconciliation. The same PayPal capture must resolve to the existing row and must not append a second reconciliation event.

exec: pm.test('Repeated reconciliation is idempotent', function () { pm.expect(d.ok).to.eql(true); pm.expect(d.reconciled).to.eql(true); pm.expect(d.duplicate).to.eql(true); });
